Ramblings, Update, Sports, and Thoughts Pt. 7 11/14/2026

Published on November 13, 2026 by CP

It’s been more than a month since I last posted. My new “fans” were giddy for the next post, so I had to dust off the ol’ qwerty for this one. To be honest, I don’t like posting and writing stuff on here that much anymore. The website’s become more of a burden than a blessing at this point. In the beginning, it was fun and lighthearted, but nowadays it serves as yet another medium used to make fun of me, though I can’t say I’m not used to that.

From the first post I ever made in June, I said the blog was corny, so I’m not really surprised by the reactions I’ve received so far. I thought by having a blog I’d become cool, deep, and niche. I thought It’d be embraced by friends and family to an extent, but that didn’t really happen. Instead, I just sound like a corny, cynical loser, and I’m still not much better at writing. I thought I’d develop a Bourdain-esque raw writing style, but I lowkey just sound like a loser with idiotic ideas. So it goes. Maybe it’s my nature to be a corny loser, so please keep clowning my post. I can take it.

I might even be a horrible person too. I get that people aren't always gonna agree with the things you're gonna say, but I lowkey sound like a villain half the time. Most of my ideas come off as if I’m President Business trying to subjugate people to my way of thinking, but I promise I’m not gonna use the Kragle on everyone who doesn’t think how I think.

All that said, I let myself down and y’all down by not posting for a month. I pledged at the beginning of the school year to post about 3-5 per month. I haven’t upheld that promise, so I pledge to post at least 3 times a month starting after this post. I can’t expect anything of others when I don’t expect anything from myself.

I had no plans for this entry. I haven’t written that many thoughts down lately, and I don’t want to write a thoughts part 7 because that’s pretty much what I do all the time now. I want to do more real writing. Even though y’all clowned my shit, I’m gonna do an update like last time. Then, the rest will be sports and finally thoughts pt. 7.

Sports

As for college football, Alabama is somehow the third-best team in the country with 2 losses. As a Bama fan, I wholeheartedly believe we are not the 3rd-best team in the country, and I don’t think we’ll win the Natty. That ranking is glaze and committee bias. I also don’t trust DeBoer or the team in any game we play. Every game since Saban left has felt like flipping a coin, and somehow that coin lands on whatever side we want it to almost every game.

My Memphis Tigers have started well in college basketball this year. We beat No. 18 Iowa State, then proceeded to get fucked by Vandy the following week. We got No. 10 Louisville Tomorrow, so hopefully that goes well. I just want them to have a decent season and possibly make March Madness. Regarding Bama, I trust Nate Oats to deliver once again. We’re gonna have some tough games in December, but I don’t think it's anything we can’t handle.

My Wolves are currently 9-3. It’s too early to comment on them just yet. Hopefully Ant comes back to lead us to the promised land this year. However, that will require stepping up from Gobert.

Niners are 7-1. Going into the season, I thought the Seahawks and Rams would dominate our roster of old geezers in conference play, but that hasn’t happened. Somehow, we keep winning, something the Titans can’t say.

I’d like to shed light on the NAU-Kentucky game last night. I hate Kentucky basketball so much. No. 24 Kentucky almost let a 0-3 NAU team beat them at home. If the NAU players learned how to shoot free throws, then they probably would have won the game. NAU could have had the win on the first free throw, but the dude missed it. Then Kentucky gave it right back to them, only for NAU to miss it again. How does Kentucky win it on a stepback 3? Wilkins pulled that 3 out of his ass. Was that shit in there all game? I hate Kentucky and can’t wait to see how they fare in SEC play.

Thinking about it now, I probably should have stopped and said something, but I just waved and kept running. In that moment, I felt like the fast alien with the red shoes that always passes you at some point in Run 3.
